# Draft:AIR Awards of 2025

----
| next             = 2026
}}
The 2025 AIR Awards is the upcoming nineteenth annual Australian Independent Record Labels Association Music Awards ceremony (generally known as the AIR Awards), scheduled to take place on 31 July 2025 in Adelaide. The 2025 AIR Awards will introduce a new category; the Independent Mix, Studio or Mastering Engineer of the Year.
Performances
TBA
Nominees and winners
Nominations opened up to AIR members on February 4th and will close on March 10th.
